     #[tokio::test]
+    async fn successful_claims_update_workspace_for_the_same_telemetry_session() {
+        let first = make_bead("needle-workspace-first", "/tmp/needle-workspace-first");
+        let second = make_bead("needle-workspace-second", "/tmp/needle-workspace-second");
+        let store = Arc::new(MockBeadStore::new(vec![first.clone(), second.clone()]));
+        let (sink, events) = MemorySink::new();
+        let telemetry = Telemetry::with_sink("test-worker".to_string(), sink);
+        let claimer = Claimer::new(store, std::env::temp_dir(), 5, 10, telemetry.clone());
+
+        claimer
+            .claim_next(
+                std::slice::from_ref(&first),
+                "worker-1",
+                &HashSet::new(),
+                "test-strand",
+            )
+            .await
+            .unwrap();
+        claimer
+            .claim_next(
+                std::slice::from_ref(&second),
+                "worker-1",
+                &HashSet::new(),
+                "test-strand",
+            )
+            .await
+            .unwrap();
+
+        drop(claimer);
+        drop(telemetry);
+        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
+
+        let successes: Vec<_> = events
+            .lock()
+            .unwrap()
+            .iter()
+            .filter(|event| event.event_type == "bead.claim.succeeded")
+            .cloned()
+            .collect();
+        assert_eq!(successes.len(), 2);
+        assert_eq!(
+            successes[0].workspace.as_deref(),
+            Some(first.workspace.as_path())
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            successes[1].workspace.as_deref(),
+            Some(second.workspace.as_path())
+        );
+    }

+    /// The path is kept internally so local sinks and query filters can retain
+    /// their existing behavior. The OTLP sink reduces it to a basename before
+    /// adding the browser-visible log attribute.
+    pub fn set_workspace(&self, workspace: impl Into<PathBuf>) {
+        let workspace = workspace.into();
+        match self.current_workspace.write() {
+            Ok(mut current) => *current = Some(workspace),
+            Err(poisoned) => {
+                tracing::warn!("telemetry workspace lock poisoned; recovering current workspace");
+                *poisoned.into_inner() = Some(workspace);
+            }
+        }
+    }

+                tracing::warn!("telemetry workspace lock poisoned; recovering workspace snapshot");
+                poisoned.into_inner().clone()
+            }
+        }
+    }

+    pub fn set_workspace(&self, workspace: impl Into<PathBuf>) {

+        match self.current_workspace.write() {

+    pub fn set_workspace(&self, workspace: impl Into<PathBuf>) {

+        let (sink, events) = MemorySink::new();

+        let claimer = Claimer::new(store, std::env::temp_dir(), 5, 10, telemetry.clone());
+
+        claimer
+            .claim_next(
+                std::slice::from_ref(&first),
+                "worker-1",
+                &HashSet::new(),
+                "test-strand",
+            )
+            .await
+            .unwrap();
+        claimer
+            .claim_next(
+                std::slice::from_ref(&second),
+                "worker-1",
+                &HashSet::new(),
+                "test-strand",
+            )
+            .await
+            .unwrap();
+

+        drop(telemetry);
+        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
+
+        let successes: Vec<_> = events
+            .lock()
+            .unwrap()
+            .iter()
+            .filter(|event| event.event_type == "bead.claim.succeeded")
+            .cloned()
+            .collect();
+        assert_eq!(successes.len(), 2);
+        assert_eq!(
+            successes[0].workspace.as_deref(),
+            Some(first.workspace.as_path())
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            successes[1].workspace.as_deref(),
+            Some(second.workspace.as_path())
+        );

+    pub fn set_workspace(&self, workspace: impl Into<PathBuf>) {
+        let workspace = workspace.into();
+        match self.current_workspace.write() {
+            Ok(mut current) => *current = Some(workspace),
+            Err(poisoned) => {
+                tracing::warn!("telemetry workspace lock poisoned; recovering current workspace");
+                *poisoned.into_inner() = Some(workspace);
+            }
+        }

+    pub fn set_workspace(&self, workspace: impl Into<PathBuf>) {

+        match self.current_workspace.write() {

+    pub fn set_workspace(&self, workspace: impl Into<PathBuf>) {
+        let workspace = workspace.into();
+        match self.current_workspace.write() {
+            Ok(mut current) => *current = Some(workspace),
+            Err(poisoned) => {
+                tracing::warn!("telemetry workspace lock poisoned; recovering current workspace");
+                *poisoned.into_inner() = Some(workspace);
+            }
+        }
+    }

+                poisoned.into_inner().clone()

+        let second = make_bead("needle-workspace-second", "/tmp/needle-workspace-second");
+        let store = Arc::new(MockBeadStore::new(vec![first.clone(), second.clone()]));
+        let (sink, events) = MemorySink::new();
+        let telemetry = Telemetry::with_sink("test-worker".to_string(), sink);
+        let claimer = Claimer::new(store, std::env::temp_dir(), 5, 10, telemetry.clone());
+
+        claimer
+            .claim_next(
+                std::slice::from_ref(&first),
+                "worker-1",
+                &HashSet::new(),
+                "test-strand",
+            )
+            .await
+            .unwrap();
+        claimer
+            .claim_next(
+                std::slice::from_ref(&second),
+                "worker-1",
+                &HashSet::new(),
+                "test-strand",
+            )
+            .await
+            .unwrap();
+
+        drop(claimer);
+        drop(telemetry);
+        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
+
+        let successes: Vec<_> = events
+            .lock()
+            .unwrap()
+            .iter()
+            .filter(|event| event.event_type == "bead.claim.succeeded")
+            .cloned()
+            .collect();
+        assert_eq!(successes.len(), 2);
+        assert_eq!(
+            successes[0].workspace.as_deref(),
+            Some(first.workspace.as_path())
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            successes[1].workspace.as_deref(),
+            Some(second.workspace.as_path())
+        );
+    }

+    /// The path is kept internally so local sinks and query filters can retain
+    /// their existing behavior. The OTLP sink reduces it to a basename before
+    /// adding the browser-visible log attribute.
+    pub fn set_workspace(&self, workspace: impl Into<PathBuf>) {
+        let workspace = workspace.into();
+        match self.current_workspace.write() {
+            Ok(mut current) => *current = Some(workspace),
+            Err(poisoned) => {
+                tracing::warn!("telemetry workspace lock poisoned; recovering current workspace");
+                *poisoned.into_inner() = Some(workspace);
+            }
+        }
+    }

+                tracing::warn!("telemetry workspace lock poisoned; recovering workspace snapshot");
+                poisoned.into_inner().clone()
+            }
+        }

+    pub fn set_workspace(&self, workspace: impl Into<PathBuf>) {

+        match self.current_workspace.write() {

+    pub fn set_workspace(&self, workspace: impl Into<PathBuf>) {

+        match self.current_workspace.write() {
+            Ok(mut current) => *current = Some(workspace),
+            Err(poisoned) => {

+                *poisoned.into_inner() = Some(workspace);

+        }

+    pub fn set_workspace(&self, workspace: impl Into<PathBuf>) {
+        let workspace = workspace.into();
+        match self.current_workspace.write() {
+            Ok(mut current) => *current = Some(workspace),
+            Err(poisoned) => {
+                tracing::warn!("telemetry workspace lock poisoned; recovering current workspace");
+                *poisoned.into_inner() = Some(workspace);
+            }
+        }
+    }

+                poisoned.into_inner().clone()

+        }

+        let first = make_bead("needle-workspace-first", "/tmp/needle-workspace-first");
+        let second = make_bead("needle-workspace-second", "/tmp/needle-workspace-second");
+        let store = Arc::new(MockBeadStore::new(vec![first.clone(), second.clone()]));
+        let (sink, events) = MemorySink::new();
+        let telemetry = Telemetry::with_sink("test-worker".to_string(), sink);
+        let claimer = Claimer::new(store, std::env::temp_dir(), 5, 10, telemetry.clone());
+
+        claimer
+            .claim_next(
+                std::slice::from_ref(&first),
+                "worker-1",
+                &HashSet::new(),
+                "test-strand",
+            )
+            .await
+            .unwrap();
+        claimer
+            .claim_next(
+                std::slice::from_ref(&second),
+                "worker-1",
+                &HashSet::new(),
+                "test-strand",
+            )
+            .await
+            .unwrap();
+
+        drop(claimer);
+        drop(telemetry);
+        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
+
+        let successes: Vec<_> = events
+            .lock()
+            .unwrap()
+            .iter()
+            .filter(|event| event.event_type == "bead.claim.succeeded")
+            .cloned()
+            .collect();
+        assert_eq!(successes.len(), 2);
+        assert_eq!(
+            successes[0].workspace.as_deref(),
+            Some(first.workspace.as_path())
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            successes[1].workspace.as_deref(),
+            Some(second.workspace.as_path())
+        );

+    pub fn set_workspace(&self, workspace: impl Into<PathBuf>) {
+        let workspace = workspace.into();
+        match self.current_workspace.write() {
+            Ok(mut current) => *current = Some(workspace),
+            Err(poisoned) => {
+                tracing::warn!("telemetry workspace lock poisoned; recovering current workspace");
+                *poisoned.into_inner() = Some(workspace);

+        }

+    async fn successful_claims_update_workspace_for_the_same_telemetry_session() {
+        let first = make_bead("needle-workspace-first", "/tmp/needle-workspace-first");
+        let second = make_bead("needle-workspace-second", "/tmp/needle-workspace-second");
+        let store = Arc::new(MockBeadStore::new(vec![first.clone(), second.clone()]));
+        let (sink, events) = MemorySink::new();
+        let telemetry = Telemetry::with_sink("test-worker".to_string(), sink);
+        let claimer = Claimer::new(store, std::env::temp_dir(), 5, 10, telemetry.clone());
+
+        claimer
+            .claim_next(
+                std::slice::from_ref(&first),
+                "worker-1",
+                &HashSet::new(),
+                "test-strand",
+            )
+            .await
+            .unwrap();
+        claimer
+            .claim_next(
+                std::slice::from_ref(&second),
+                "worker-1",
+                &HashSet::new(),
+                "test-strand",
+            )
+            .await
+            .unwrap();
+
+        drop(claimer);
+        drop(telemetry);
+        tokio::time::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50)).await;
+
+        let successes: Vec<_> = events
+            .lock()
+            .unwrap()
+            .iter()
+            .filter(|event| event.event_type == "bead.claim.succeeded")
+            .cloned()
+            .collect();
+        assert_eq!(successes.len(), 2);
+        assert_eq!(
+            successes[0].workspace.as_deref(),
+            Some(first.workspace.as_path())
+        );
+        assert_eq!(
+            successes[1].workspace.as_deref(),
+            Some(second.workspace.as_path())
+        );
+    }

+    /// The path is kept internally so local sinks and query filters can retain
+    /// their existing behavior. The OTLP sink reduces it to a basename before
+    /// adding the browser-visible log attribute.
+    pub fn set_workspace(&self, workspace: impl Into<PathBuf>) {
+        let workspace = workspace.into();
+        match self.current_workspace.write() {
+            Ok(mut current) => *current = Some(workspace),
+            Err(poisoned) => {
+                tracing::warn!("telemetry workspace lock poisoned; recovering current workspace");
+                *poisoned.into_inner() = Some(workspace);
+            }
+        }
+    }

+            Err(poisoned) => {
+                tracing::warn!("telemetry workspace lock poisoned; recovering workspace snapshot");
+                poisoned.into_inner().clone()
+            }
+        }
+    }

 succeeded in 0ms:
ID: needle-5359b52a
Title: TelemetryEvent.workspace is hardcoded None — dashboard Repo cannot track a roaming worker
Status: Closed
Priority: P1
Revision: 7
Created: 2026-08-16T04:47:31.694380307Z
Updated: 2026-08-17T05:11:59.145928726Z
Description: ## Problem

The dashboard resolves a worker's repo as:
  attrs["workspace"] or data["workspace"] or resource["needle.workspace"]
(needle-dashboard configmap, normalize_otlp_log).

Its FIRST choice is the per-record log attribute `workspace`.
OtlpSink::emit_log does set that attribute — but only
`if let Some(ref workspace) = event.workspace`, and BOTH emit paths hardcode
the field to None:

  src/telemetry/mod.rs:3323  (Telemetry::emit)
  src/telemetry/mod.rs:3488  (Telemetry::emit_sync)

The field is declared (mod.rs:71), documented in plan.md telemetry module spec,
filterable via the query layer (mod.rs:4023), and read by the OTLP sink — and is
never once populated. It is dead code with a live consumer.

## Why the resource fallback is not good enough

worker_telemetry_identity() (src/cli/mod.rs:849) resolves
workspace = config.workspace.default ONCE at boot, onto an OTel Resource, which
is immutable for the process lifetime. A NEEDLE worker roams: `needle run -w`
says so in its own help text — "NOT an exclusive scope. The Explore strand still
auto-discovers every directory containing .beads/ under
strands.explore.workspace_root, so the worker can claim beads in other repos."

Confirmed live: workers launched -w /home/coding/aide-de-camp are dispatching in
commitgraph, SEAM, and tradegraph. A resource-scoped workspace would report
aide-de-camp forever — a confidently WRONG Repo field, which is worse than blank.

## Deliverables

- Telemetry gains a current-workspace cell, updated when a claim binds the
  worker to a workspace. Bead.workspace (src/claim/mod.rs:609) is the
  authoritative source and is already known before dispatch — no new
  cross-module plumbing required.
- emit/emit_sync read that cell instead of writing None.
- Basename reduction stays in workspace_label (otlp.rs:68); full filesystem
  paths must never reach the browser contract.

## Acceptance

- A captured OTLP log record carries a `workspace` attribute equal to the repo
  basename of the bead currently claimed.
- The attribute CHANGES when the same worker claims a bead in a different
  repository within one session.
- No full path appears in any exported attribute.

Blocked by needle-a8a6e16e (same files; and until the resource hop is fixed the
end-to-end result cannot be observed).

See docs/adr/016-otlp-resource-propagation-and-roaming-worker-identity.md and
plan.md Phase 17 (17.3).
Assignee: codex-gpt-5.6-luna-xhigh-luna-seam
Type: bug
